cases.name: if-on-data-drops-comma
cases.description: A false condition on <data> contributes nothing
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data><data if="!_last">,</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-on-line-drops-the-row
cases.description: A false condition on <line> drops the whole line
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="1..80"/></sequence></env><block><line if="Age >= 18"><data>${{Age}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: expression-precedence
cases.description: && binds tighter than ||, and comparison tighter than both
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..100"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data><data if="N > 10 && N < 20 || N == 100">*</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: dotted-value-test
cases.description: Gender.Male reads as "is Gender currently Male"
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Gender"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Gender}}</data><data if="Gender.Male">!</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: parent-filter
cases.description: A child column is empty on the rows its parent did not select
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Gender"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="M" parent="Gender.Male"><gen type="text" value="m"/></sequence><sequence name="F" parent="Gender.Female"><gen type="text" value="f"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Gender}},${{M}},${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compound-sequence
cases.description: A compound registers each field under Name.Field
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="P"><gen name="A" type="number" value="1..9"/><gen name="B" type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{P.A}}/${{P.B}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: conditional-sequence
cases.description: A conditional takes its first matching branch
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="1..80"/></sequence><sequence name="Group"><gen if="Age < 18" type="text" value="minor"/><gen if="Age < 65" type="text" value="adult"/><gen type="text" value="senior"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},${{Group}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: repeat-and-each
cases.description: repeat makes a list, each walks it into one line per element
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="each-demo" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="Tags"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="0..3" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>card ${{Id}}: ${{Tags}}</data></line><line each="Tags"><data>  ${{_item_id}}/${{_item}} ${{Tags}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: fixtures-nest
cases.description: The wrappers nest and the delimiters go only between
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><before><line><data>[</data></line></before><after><line><data>]</data></line></after><before_block><line><data>  {</data></line></before_block><after_block><line><data>  }</data></line></after_block><delimiter_block><line><data>  ,</data></line></delimiter_block></env><block><line><data>    ${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: builtins
cases.description: _count, _first, _last and _total are positional and take no draws
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="text" value="x"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{_count}}/${{_total}} first=${{_first}} last=${{_last}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: default-engine-is-disk-mode
cases.description: no mode= at all: the run routes the way an unannotated config does, not to memory
cases.config: <tdc version="0.1.0"><env count="8" seed="default-route" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="75,25"/></sequence><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{G}}:${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: dotted-version-is-accepted
cases.description: version="0.1.0" — three parts, the form this runtime declares for itself
cases.config: <tdc version="0.1.0"><env mode="memory" count="3" seed="ver" local="en"><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>id=${{Id}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: template-address-named-by-another-column
cases.description: a template whose pack address interpolates a sibling — the model list follows the make
cases.config: <tdc><env mode="memory" count="6" seed="showroom" local="en"><sequence name="Brand"><gen type="template" value="common.vehicle.brand"/></sequence><sequence name="Model" parent="Brand"><gen type="template" value="common.vehicle.model.${{Brand}}"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Brand}} ${{Model}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: anomaly-flag-names-a-column
cases.description: anomaly_flag= on a <gen> declares a real column, referenced like any other
cases.config: <tdc><env mode="memory" count="8" seed="flagged" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="10..20" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_flag="F"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}} ${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: composed-sequence-joins-its-unnamed-gens
cases.description: unnamed <gen>s and the <data> literals between them concatenate into the sequence's own value
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="composed" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/><data>-</data><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: composed-sequence-keeps-named-gens-as-fields
cases.description: a named <gen> beside unnamed ones is a field, not part of the value
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="composed" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/><data>-</data><gen name="f" type="text" value="x,y"/><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}|${{V.f}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: named-data-is-a-constant-field
cases.description: <data name="c"> inside a sequence is a constant field, and the body has no value of its own
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="constant" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen name="g" type="text" value="a,b"/><data name="c">F</data></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V.g}}/${{V.c}}/[${{V}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-constant-field-costs-no-draw
cases.description: inserting <data name=…> leaves every later column exactly where it was — the same body without it must render the same
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="constant" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence><sequence name="K"><gen name="g" type="text" value="x"/><data name="c">F</data><gen type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}|${{B}}|${{K.c}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: composed-sequence-with-a-literal-at-each-end
cases.description: two literals and two gens: the count of literals must not be mistaken for the count of gens
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="composed" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/><data>-</data><gen type="text" value="c,d"/><data>!</data></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: composed-value-of-a-literals-only-body
cases.description: every <gen> named and a bare <data> beside them: the sequence's own value is the literals, on every engine
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="composed" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen name="f" type="text" value="a,b"/><data>-LIT-</data></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}|${{V.f}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-literals-only-composed-value-still-obeys-its-parent
cases.description: the literals are constant but not unconditional — a row outside the filter has no value at all
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="composed" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="V" parent="G.Male"><gen name="f" type="text" value="a,b"/><data>-LIT-</data></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{G}}|[${{V}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: paired-data-emits-a-literal-close-tag
cases.description: pair= makes </data> inside the body text, while ${{…}} in the same body still interpolates
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data pair="doc">row ${{N}} prints <data>x</data></data pair="doc"></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: paired-data-body-may-close-twice
cases.description: Every literal </data> in a paired body survives, not only the first
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"></env><block><line><data pair="p">a</data>b</data>c</data pair="p"></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: paired-data-inner-close-keeps-its-own-pair
cases.description: A </data pair="q"> inside the body is text: only the matching pair closes the block
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"></env><block><line><data pair="p">a</data pair="q">b</data pair="p"></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: paired-data-neighbours-render-unchanged
cases.description: Blanking the closing tag holds its place, so the elements after it read the same
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"></env><block><line><data pair="a">1</data></data pair="a"><data>-</data><data pair="b">2</data></data pair="b"></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: paired-data-spans-lines
cases.description: A paired body carrying line breaks and a closer of its own, on separate lines
cases.config:
<tdc>
  <env count="2" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"></env>
  <block><line><data pair="doc">first
</data>
second</data pair="doc"></line></block>
</tdc>

cases.name: paired-data-self-closing-needs-no-closer
cases.description: pair= on a self-closing <data/> is inert — nothing to close, nothing to rewrite
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"></env><block><line><data>a</data><data pair="x"/><data>b</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: item-id-lanes-follow-declaration-order
cases.description: Two repeating sequences share one child table, so each gets its own slice of every card key block. The slices are handed out in the order the config DECLARES the sequences — not sorted by name, which is what Rust did until this case existed: zebra is written first and takes the first lane even though alpha sorts before it.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="lane" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="zebra"><gen type="number" value="1..9" repeat="2"/></sequence><sequence name="alpha"><gen type="number" value="1..9" repeat="3"/></sequence></env><block><line each="zebra"><data>Z ${{_item_id}}</data></line><line each="alpha"><data>A ${{_item_id}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: each-list-positions-and-element-conditions
cases.description: On a line walking a list, Tags._item, Tags._first and Tags._last count the printed elements, and every if= on the line — the line's own and each <data>'s — is asked of the element, not of the whole row: Tags == b is true on the line printing b, whatever else the row's list holds.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="each-list-pos" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="Tags"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="0..4" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>card ${{Id}}: ${{Tags}}</data></line><line each="Tags" if="Tags != c"><data>  ${{Tags._item}}:${{Tags}}</data><data if="Tags == b"> (bee)</data><data if="Tags._first"> first</data><data if="!Tags._last">,</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: each-in-a-fixture-splits-on-the-list-separator
cases.description: A fixture line walking a list splits it on the list's own separator and keys its elements the way a block line does. Four ports handed fixture lines no list information at all, so a list joined with ; came out as one element and _item_id took another stride.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="each-fixture-sep" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Tags"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="2..3" separator=";"/></sequence><before><line each="Tags"><data>head ${{_item_id}}:${{Tags}}</data></line></before></env><block><line><data>row ${{Tags}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-each-nests-one-pool-inside-another
cases.description: <group each="Depts"> prints its lines once per department, with the department in scope for every line inside — so an inner group walking Doctors can keep the doctors of THAT department (Doctors.dept.id == Depts.id). Each level counts its own positions: Doctors._last is the last doctor printed in this department, Depts._last the last department. A department with no doctor prints an empty array.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="group-nest" local="en" mode="memory"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="name"><gen type="text" value="Cardiology,Neurology,Surgery" order="sequential"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Doctors" count="5"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="last"><gen type="text" value="Adams,Baker,Clark,Davis,Evans" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="dept"><gen type="pool" value="Depts"/></sequence><sequence name="langs"><gen type="text" value="en,es,pl" repeat="1..2" separator=";" distinct="true"/></sequence></pool></env><block><line><data>[</data></line><group each="Depts"><line><data>  {"name": ${{Depts.name | json}}, "doctors": [</data></line><group each="Doctors" if="Doctors.dept.id == Depts.id"><line><data>    {"id": ${{Doctors.id}}, "name": ${{Doctors.last | json}},</data></line><line><data>     "langs": ${{Doctors.langs | json:;}}, "n": ${{Doctors._item}}}</data><data if="!Doctors._last">,</data></line></group><line><data>  ]}</data><data if="!Depts._last">,</data></line></group><line><data>]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-each-list-prints-several-lines-per-element
cases.description: A group walking a list prints all its lines for each element, _item and _item_id included, and nothing at all for a record whose list is empty.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="group-list" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="Tags"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="0..3" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>card ${{Id}}</data></line><group each="Tags"><line><data>  begin ${{_item_id}}/${{Tags._item}} ${{Tags}}</data></line><line><data>  end ${{Tags}}</data><data if="Tags._last"> (last)</data></line></group></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-if-keeps-or-drops-its-lines-together
cases.description: <group if="…"> without each= decides all its lines at once, in the scope around it — one condition instead of the same one on every line. A group inside a group each= reads the element; a line inside a group keeps its own if=.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="group-if" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="visit,call"/></sequence><sequence name="Tags"><gen type="text" value="x,y" repeat="1..2" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>#${{Id}} ${{Kind}}</data></line><group if="Kind == visit"><line><data>  room</data></line><line><data>  doctor</data></line><group each="Tags"><group if="Tags == y"><line><data>  tag ${{Tags}}</data></line></group></group><line if="Id > 3"><data>  late</data></line></group></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-in-a-fixture
cases.description: A fixture may hold a group too, so a lookup table of several lines per record prints once, ahead of the rows.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="group-fixture" local="en" mode="memory"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="name"><gen type="text" value="Cardiology,Neurology,Surgery" order="sequential"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><before><group each="Depts"><line><data>dept ${{Depts.id}}</data></line><line><data>  name ${{Depts.name}}</data></line></group></before></env><block><line><data>row ${{Id}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: fixture-line-if-is-read
cases.description: The if= of a fixture line is read on the row the fixture stands beside — <before> the first, <after> the last, the per-record fixtures their own row. It used to be ignored in all five, so a line the config said to leave out was printed anyway.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="fixture-if" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><before><line if="Id == 1"><data>first row is 1</data></line><line if="Id == 2"><data>never printed</data></line></before><before_block><line if="Kind == a"><data>-- an a --</data></line></before_block><after><line if="Id == 4"><data>last row is 4</data></line></after></env><block><line><data>${{Id}} ${{Kind}}</data></line></block></tdc>
